title: HOME REPAIR SKILLS EVERY HOME OWNER SHOULD KNOW
description:
Do you own your home? Maybe it's your first home and you've never had to deal with some pretty common issues before... In this video, Sandee shares a handful of things that you SHOULD know how to do all on your own. Plus, she throws in some tips and tricks that could save you some money along the way!
